cell_type.evidence: Here, we show that supplementation of low-dose multiple nutrients (an important environmental factor) can modulate synaptic proteomes, reconfigure neural ensembles, and improve social behaviours in mice.

disease_state.evidence: We first used Tbr1+/- mice, a well-established model of ASD, to investigate the effect of  1/4 cocktail (containing Ile 0.1125%, Leu 0.225%, Val 0.1125%, 1% serine and 20 ppm zinc) in drinking water.

material_type.evidence: Whole brains of mice treated with cocktail for one week were homogenized using a tissue Dounce homogenizer with a loose pestle in 1 mL sucrose buffer [50 mM Tris-Cl pH 7.4, 320 mM sucrose, 2 mM DTT, 2 mg/ml leupeptin, 2 mg/ml pepstatin-A, 2 mg/ml aproteinin, 2 mM PMSF, 2 mg/ml MG132].
